worked_example.problem: During a lesson the electricity goes off, but the computers stay on for a few minutes so pupils can save their work. Which device made this possible?
steps: A device that keeps computers running for a short time when power fails is a UPS.
It gives time to save work and shut down safely.

cards.idea: A computer laboratory has computers, a projector, printers and scanners.
example: The projector shows the teacher’s screen on the wall.

cards.idea: A UPS and stabilisers protect computers from power cuts and changes.
example: A UPS gives time to save your work.

cards.idea: Safety equipment includes a CO₂ fire extinguisher for electrical fires and a first-aid box.
example: Never use water on an electrical fire.

check.prompt: Which fire extinguisher is used on an electrical fire in the computer laboratory?

wrong.explain: Water conducts electricity: never use it on an electrical fire.

wrong.text: a wet cloth thrown on the computer
wrong.explain: Water and electricity are dangerous together.
A fan feeds the fire with air.

wrong.text: sand from the garden poured into the computer
wrong.explain: Use the CO₂ extinguisher and call an adult.

questions.prompt: Match each device with its use.

pool.right: shows the teacher’s screen on the wall
turns paper documents into pictures on the computer
keeps computers running for a short time when the power goes off
connects the computers into a network
keeps the room and the computers cool

pick.why: Computer: for pupils to work on.

pick.t: shows the teacher’s screen on the wall
pick.why: Projector: shows the teacher’s screen on the wall.

pick.t: turns paper documents into pictures on the computer
pick.why: Scanner: turns paper documents into pictures on the computer.

pick.t: keeps computers running for a short time when the power goes off
pick.why: UPS (uninterruptible power supply): keeps computers running for a short time when the power goes off.

pick.t: connects the computers into a network
pick.why: Router or switch: connects the computers into a network.
Fire extinguisher (CO₂): puts out electrical fires.

pick.t: keeps the room and the computers cool
pick.why: Air conditioner or fan: keeps the room and the computers cool.

misconceptions.explain: That device has a different use.

questions.prompt: Why does a computer laboratory need a UPS?

right.text: to keep computers running for a short time when the power fails, so work can be saved

wrong.explain: A router connects to the Internet; a UPS gives power.
A fan or air conditioner cools.

wrong.text: to show the screen on the wall

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: A projector shows the teacher’s screen on the wall.
A router connects computers into a network.
A CO₂ extinguisher is used on electrical fires.

wrong.text: Water is the best way to put out an electrical fire.

wrong.explain: A printer prints; a scanner copies paper into the computer.

wrong.text: A UPS makes the computers faster.
wrong.explain: A UPS keeps them running during a power cut.
